name: printer_command
description: Query and control Bambu Lab 3D printers. Use 'status' to check what's printing. Use 'pause', 'resume', or 'stop' to control an active print job.

parameters.description: The printer command. Use 'status' to check printer states and progress. 'pause' to pause a print. 'resume' to continue a paused print. 'stop' to cancel a print job.
Optional name of the specific printer to target, e.g. 'X1 Carbon', 'A1 Mini'. If only one printer is active it is used automatically.
